name: Binance BTC/USDT signed aggressor flow
description: Each verified buyer-aggressed Binance BTC/USDT trade contributes positive price-times-size notional and positive base size; each seller-aggressed trade contributes negative values. Outputs sum those contributions over causal 1-, 10-, and 60-second receipt-time windows of (window close minus duration, window close]. Ready output requires 60 seconds of uninterrupted Binance observation and Binance demonstrably alive. A trade-quiet but live Binance connection — any admitted Binance input event within staleness_bound_ms — contributes truthful zeros (flow_direction_10s = "flat"); no admitted Binance input within that bound keeps degrading as trade_venue_stale_or_missing. This identity is single-venue: it reads only Binance inputs and is ready whenever Binance is warmed and alive, independently of the other adopted spot venue. The blended `btc.external.*` reading of the same measurement stays the reference layer and continues to require every adopted venue (ADR 0024). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even. Venue port (B1): this identity is the Binance sibling of `btc.coinbase.aggressor_flow@1.0.0` and reuses that definition's formulas, windows, thresholds, warm-up, staleness bound, field set, field types and eight-place round-half-to-even rounding verbatim; only the source ids differ (`crates/btc-signals/src/spot_signals.rs`, `crates/btc-signals/src/candidate_spot_signals.rs`). The instrument is Binance spot BTCUSDT; at decision time every price-level field is converted from the venue's USDT quote to USD via the Kraken USDT/USD mid, while ratio fields (basis points, imbalances, ratios, counts) are quote-currency neutral. Binance inputs are rights-gated (`signals/knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md`): the lane is built and tested to the adopted standard, and its runtime refuses to start unless the environment allow-list `SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES` names `binance`, which the deployment sets only after that row clears. The Binance trade input is the `btcusdt@aggTrade` stream: one message is an aggregate of fills at one price on one side at one `trade_time`, with `aggressor_side` derived from `buyer_is_maker`. Aggregation preserves price, side and time, so every formula over signed price-times-size is unchanged; `trade_count` fields count aggregate trades, not individual fills, and the identity states that. quote_currency is emitted on every decision and is the constant "usd" for this venue: every price-denominated field is converted from the venue's USDT quote to USD via the Kraken USDT/USD mid, while ratio, basis-point, base-size and count fields are quote-currency neutral. The signed_notional_usd_1s, signed_notional_usd_10s, signed_notional_usd_60s and gross_notional_usd_60s field names are retained unchanged so the family's field set stays identical across all venues; for this venue their values are USDT notional, as quote_currency declares. E47 (USD quoting): this identity quotes in USD. The venue trades BTC against USDT, so at decision time every price, notional and quote-denominated cost field (signed_notional_usd_1s, signed_notional_usd_10s, signed_notional_usd_60s, gross_notional_usd_60s) is converted USDT to USD with the latest USDT/USD reference rate; base-denominated fields (base sizes, counts, basis-point ratios, durations) are unchanged. The reference is kraken.spot.usdt-usd.ticker, delivered on the dedicated Kraken reference socket (a second reference, coinbase.exchange.usdt-usd.ticker, joins when it lands). quote_currency is the constant "usd". usdt_usd_rate (decimal, eight places, round-half-to-even) and usdt_usd_rate_age_ms are published on every ready decision, and the identity is non-ready with reason usdt_reference_stale when the rate is absent or older than 60000 milliseconds.
